consequence.statement: Operators must upgrade sequentially one minor version at a time and be on a v1.20 version before upgrading to v2.0, so CRD migrations run at each minor release.
consequence.remediation: Upgrade sequentially through each v1 minor up to v1.20, then upgrade to v2.0.

original.statement: Upgrading to Crossplane v2.0 should be done from v1.20, going sequentially through each v1 minor version, because each minor upgrade migrates CRDs so the latest versions are stored.

decision.reason: [ev-8df0afdc905e] says CRD storage migrations run at each minor upgrade, so operators have to upgrade one minor version at a time and be on v1.20 before upgrading to v2.0. That is an operator step required before the upgrade, which makes migration-required the right kind (action class). The proposed statement and remediation match the text and don't claim any failure the evidence doesn't state. Confidence is low because the upstream wording is "strongly advised" and "should", not "must", and it never says what goes wrong if you skip a version.
